output.answer_1: Draw one straight diagonal line from the top-left corner of the rectangle to the bottom-right corner. This cuts the rectangle into two triangles that are the same size and shape (two right triangles).
output.answer_2: Draw one straight vertical line from the middle of the top side straight down to the middle of the bottom side. This cuts the rectangle into two smaller rectangles of equal size.
output.answer_3: Draw a first straight vertical line from the top side down to the bottom side, about one-third of the way across from the left side, so the rectangle is split into a narrow rectangle on the left and a wider part on the right. Then draw a second straight diagonal line from the top end of that vertical line to the bottom-right corner of the big rectangle. This leaves 1 rectangle on the left and 2 triangles on the right, one above and one below the diagonal.
